views.name: player_debut_final
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    p."player_id" AS player_id,
    p."debut" AS debut_date,
    p."final_game" AS final_date
FROM "player" AS p
views.description: Selects player debut and final game dates.

views.name: date_diff_years
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(JULIANDAY('final_game') - JULIANDAY('debut') / 365 AS REAL) AS years
FROM player_debut_final
views.description: Calculates the difference in years between debut and final dates.

views.name: player_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    p.name_first AS player_name,
    SUM(b.g) AS games_played,
    SUM(b.r) AS runs,
    SUM(b.h) AS hits,
    SUM(b.hr) AS home_runs
FROM player AS p
JOIN batting AS b
    ON p.player_id = b.player_id
GROUP BY p.name_first
views.description: Aggregates player statistics from individual game records.

views.name: top_player
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    p.name_first AS player_name,
    SUM(b.r + b.h + b.hr + b.rbi + b.sb) AS max_score
FROM batting AS b
JOIN player AS p
    ON b.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.name_first
ORDER BY max_score DESC
LIMIT 1
views.description: Identifies the player with the highest combined score.
